faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District & Sessions Judge South Salmara Mankachar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the District & Sessions Judge South Salmara Mankachar Recruitment 2026 is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Administrative Assistant (UDA) and Bench Clerk-Grade-III posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the District & Sessions Judge South Salmara Mankachar Recruitment 2026. These are distributed between the Senior Administrative Assistant (UDA) and Bench Clerk-Grade-III positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum service requirement for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have served as Junior Administrative Assistant (JAA) in the District & Sessions Judges Establishment, Assam, for not less than 5 years as on the 1st day of July 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the District & Sessions Judge South Salmara Mankachar Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. This makes the application process more accessible to all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates ranges from Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 70,000 per month, with additional Grade Pay depending on the post. Senior Administrative Assistant (UDA) gets GP Rs. 8,000, and Bench Clerk-Grade-III gets GP Rs. 7,400.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the District & Sessions Judge South Salmara Mankachar Recruitment 2026 primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District & Sessions Judge South Salmara Mankachar, which is https://southsalmara.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the filled application form.

faq.answer: The official notification does not specify minimum or maximum age limits. However, the eligibility is based on having served as a Junior Administrative Assistant (JAA) for at least 5 years as of July 1, 2026.
